thought.text: Tadi `/v1/models` di `api.nomask.ai` memberi JSON, tapi `nomask.ai/v1` mengembalikan HTML. Saya cari URL yang benar.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && K="nmk_live_h6sUfOhMTBLD4GyNrx45jaeJDjhtMC6yCtfGegZC"; for u in "https://api.nomask.ai/v1/models" "https://api.nomask.ai/v1/chat/completions"; do echo "=== $u ==="; if [[ $u == *models ]]; then curl -s --max-time 25 -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" "$u" | python3 -c "
import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('model:',[m['id'] for m in d['data']])" 2>&1 | head -3; else curl -s --max-time 60 -X POST "$u" -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Balas: OK"}],"max_tokens":20,"force_string_serializer":true}' -w "\n[%{http_code}]" | head -c 350; fi; echo; done
